text_sheet.text: 1.	GFCI FACEPLATE RECEPTACLE MOUNTED ABOVE COUNTER, 36" AFF. COORDINATE MOUNTING HEIGHT 	WITH TENANT.2.	PROVIDE AND INSTALL JUNCTION BOX FOR POWER HAND DRYER AT 42" AFF. CIRCUIT AS INDICATED.3.	HARDWIRE CONNECTION FOR WATER CLOSETS, LAVATORIES, AND LIT MIRRORS. TYP. 4.	HYDROMASSAGE UNIT. 208 VOLT, 30 AMP DEDICATED OUTLET WITH NEMA L6-30 LOCKING RECEPTACLE. IT 	ALSO REQUIRES A 120-VOLT, NEMA 5-15 RECEPTACLE FOR TOUCHSCREEN. THIS UNIT HAS AN INTERNAL 	COOLING SYSTEM. ELECTRICAL FOR THE EXTERIOR COOLING SYSTEM IS SUPPLIED BY THE 	HYDROMASSAGE UNIT. COOLING SYSTEM MAY BE INSTALLED UP TO 25 FEET AWAY. COOLING SYSTEM 	MAY BE INSTALLED IN CEILING, BASEMENT, OR ADJACENT ROOM THAT STAYS BETWEEN 45 - 100 DEGREES 	FAHRENHEIT OR 7 - 38 DEGREES CELSIUS. E.C. SHALL VERIFY AND COORDINATE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND 	FEEDER REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO INSTALLATION.   5.	TANNING AND HYBRID BED/BOOTH. 240 VOLTS, THREE PHASE, 40 AMP DEDICATED CIRCUIT. PROVIDE 	APPROXIMATELY 6 FEET OF #8 AWG WIRE OUT OF THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BACK PANEL THROUGH 1-INCH 	LIQUID TIGHT FLEX CONNECTOR. THIS WIRE MUST BE SLEEVED WITH FLEX AND BROUGHT INTO A 	JUNCTION BOX/DISCONNECT. THIS LENGTH OF WIRE IS NECESSARY TO MOVE THE UNIT FOR SERVICE. 	E.C. SHALL VERIFY AND COORDINATE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND FEEDER REQUIREMENTS WITH 	MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO INSTALLATION.6.	BEAUTY ANGEL UNIT, 240 VOLTS, THREE PHASE, 30 AMP DEDICATED CIRCUIT. PROVIDE APPROXIMATELY 6 	FEET OF  AWG WIRE OUT OF THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BACK PANEL THROUGH A 1-INCH LIQUID TIGHT FLEX 	CONNECTOR. THIS WIRE MUST BE SLEEVED WITH FLEX AND BROUGHT INTO A JUNCTION BOX / 	DISCONNECT. THIS LENGTH IS NECESSARY TO MOVE THE UNIT FOR SERVICE. E.C. SHALL VERIFY AND 	COORDINATE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND FEEDER REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO 	INSTALLATION.7.	TRENCH (3) 2" CONDUIT FROM WALL TO MILLWORK IN CHECK-IN DESK. (1) CONDUIT FOR POWER, (1) 	CONDUIT FOR DATA, (1) CONDUIT IS SPARE. PROVIDE ISOLATED GROUND FOR CHECK-IN COMPUTER / 	PRINTER RECEPTACLES. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN TRENCH BELOW CHECK IN AREA, COORDINATE 	EXACT LOCATION WITH ARCHITECTURAL PLANS. POWER AND DATA SHALL RUN IN SEPARATE CONDUITS. 	FROM WALL, EXTEND 2" FLEX TO ACCESSIBLE CEILING SPACE.8.	ROOM FOR DATA.PHONE JACK AND RECEPTACLE FOR T-MAX MANAGER TANNING BED CONTROL. VERIFY 	INSTALLATION HEIGHT PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. WIRE TO TIMER AT EACH TANNING ROOM AS REQUIRED. SEE 	LOW VOLTAGE PLAN ON SHEET E-600 FOR T-MAX TIMER LOCATIONS. PROVIDE A SINGLE GANG BOX 	SHIELDED CAT-5 FROM T-MAX CONTROLLER AT DESK THROUGH EACH GANG BOX, TERMINATE IN LAST 	ROOM. INSTALL PER MANUFACTURERS RECOMMENDATIONS AND COORDINATE WITH OWNER.9.	LOCATION OF DATA RACK AND TELEVISION DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION OF 	RECEPTACLES WITH A/V VENDOR.10.	TV RECEPTACLE AND CONNECTION. COORDINATE TV MOUNTING HEIGHT AND CONNECTION 	REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. 11.	MOUNT RECEPTACLE SERVING DRINKING FOUNTAIN BELOW UNIT PER MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE, PER 	NEC. GFI BREAKER TO BE INSTALLED IN FEEDING PANEL. RECEPTACLE SHALL BE FULLY CONCEALED 	WITHIN DRINKING FOUNTAIN COVER.12.	TRENCH POWER AND DATA FROM END OF CRG RACEWAY TO NEAREST COLUMN OR FULL HEIGHT WALL. 	COORDINATE EXACT REQUIREMENTS WITH MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO ORDER AND/OR INSTALLATION. 	PROVIDE SEPARATE CONDUIT/RACEWAYS FOR POWER. COMPLY WITH NEC 310.15 IF APPLICABLE. 13.	PROVIDE (2) 110/USB (LEVITON GUAC2-W20A OR EQUAL) COMBO RECEPTACLES BELOW COUNTER AT +26" 	A.F.F. TO CENTER OF RECEPTACLE; VERIFY MOUNTING HEIGHT AND ORIENTATIONS WITH TENANT.14.	BEVERAGE COOLER, PROVIDE DEDICATED RECEPTACLE ON GFI CIRCUIT BREAKER PER MANUFACTURER 	INSTRUCTIONS. VERIFY MANUFACTURER, MODEL NUMBER AND QUANTITY WITH TENANT PRIOR TO 	INSTALL.15.	PROVIDE FINAL CONNECTION TO SIGNAGE. COORDINATE LOCATION AND ALL REQUIREMENTS WITH SIGN 	CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN. PROVIDE AN APPROPRIATE LOCAL DISCONNECTING MEANS 	MOUNTED IN 	AN ACCESSIBLE, INCONSPICUOUS LOCATION THAT IS WITHIN SIGHT OF THE SIGN OR WITH 	LOCKABLE MEANS. WIRED TO TIME CLOCK, PROVIDE ADDITIONAL JUNCTION BOX FOR PHOTOSENSOR. 	SIGN CIRCUIT SHALL HAVE A SEPARATE NEUTRAL CONDUCTOR. COORDINATE SIGN LOCATION WITH 	PLANET FITNESS PROJECT MANAGER AND OWNER PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.16.	COORDINATE ELECTRICAL REQUIREMENTS WITH FAN MANUFACTURER PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.17.	CLUB COM TV RECEPTACLE AND CONNECTION. COORDINATE TV MOUNTING HEIGHT AND CONNECTION 	REQUIREMENTS PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.18.	PROVIDE A FLUSH DOUBLE GANG IN-WALL FLUSH JUNCTION BOX WITH A BLANK COVER. ROUTE AN EMPTY 	3/4"C FROM JUNCTION BOX BACK TO PANEL L4 WITH PULL STRING FOR FUTURE USE.19.	INLINE EXHAUST FAN SHALL BE CONTROLLED BY WALL MOUNTED, LINE VOLTAGE THERMOSTAT, 	PROVIDED BY M.C. IN EACH ROOM. COORDINATE WITH M.C. FOR EXACT LOCATION OF THERMOSTAT 	PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.20.	GFI RECEPTACLES AT SINK VANITY SHALL BE MOUNTED ABOVE BACKSPLASH, CENTERED ON WALL SIDE-	TO-SIDE. REF ARCHITECTURAL ELEVATIONS FOR MOUNTING HEIGHT, TYP.21.	PROVIDE AND INSTALL J-BOX FOR WATER HEATER CONTROLS AT RECIRCULATION PUMP. CIRCUIT AS 	INDICATED AND PROVIDE FINAL CONNECTIONS AFTER PLUMBER INSTALLATION.22.	PROVIDE HORIZONTALLY MOUNTED RECEPTACLE AND DATA OUTLETS ABOVE COUNTER IN OFFICE AT 	50/50 DESK.23.	PLACE OUTLETS IN TANNING ROOMS SO AS TO NOT INTERFERE WITH BUILT-IN CORNER BENCHES.

IS TO BE REMOVED OR RELOCATED, ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS THAT ARE TO REMAIN SHALL BE RECONNECTED TO NEW OR RELOCATED ELECTRICAL DISTRIBUTION EQUIPMENT TO MAINTAIN THE CONTINUITY OF THOSE EXISTING CIRCUITS. INTERCEPT AND EXTEND ALL EXISTING CIRCUITS AS REQUIRED. REMOVE ALL ABANDONED TELECOMMUNICATIONS CABLING.
